usage: deskops queue [-h] {add,run,job,list} ...

Enqueue and run heavy host jobs from the repo's runs/queue.

positional arguments:
  {add,run,job,list}
    add               Enqueue one job of a kind declared in queue_jobs.
    run               Run at most one pending job (all of them with --all).
    job               Edit the queue_jobs declared in desk/config.json.
    list              List queued jobs grouped by state.

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops queue add full-suite --task task-x --transition task_hands_to_closeout --root .
  deskops queue run --root .
  deskops queue list --root . --format json
  deskops queue job set dispatch-reap retry_exit_codes '[3]' --root .
